sections.content: In historical Spanish, conectores formales para explicar relaciones históricas helps writers describe events and relationships with more distance. The structure is useful when the event matters more than the individual actor, or when two developments need to be connected in one sentence.

items.spanish: A raíz de la intervención externa, varios conflictos adquirieron una dimensión internacional, aunque sus causas también eran internas.
items.english: As a result of external intervention, several conflicts acquired an international dimension, although their causes were also internal.

items.spanish: En el marco de la Guerra Fría, las potencias apoyaron a distintos actores, mientras los gobiernos defendían sus propios intereses.
items.english: Within the framework of the Cold War, the powers supported different actors while governments defended their own interests.

items.spanish: Como consecuencia de esa intervención, los conflictos se prolongaron y la población sufrió nuevas dificultades.
items.english: As a consequence of that intervention, the conflicts lasted longer and the population suffered new difficulties.

items.spanish: La intervención tuvo efectos regionales, a pesar de que cada país siguió su propia trayectoria política.
items.english: The intervention had regional effects, even though each country followed its own political path.

sections.content: Use conectores formales para explicar relaciones históricas to link the historical event to its context, because B1 historical writing usually combines actions and consequences rather than presenting isolated statements.
